description: This is a Java source file defining a Spring MVC controller class 'ShippingPackagingController' for managing shipping packaging configurations in an e-commerce web application.

classes.name: ShippingPackagingController
classes.description: Controller class for handling shipping packaging configuration display and save operations in the admin panel.

methods.name: displayShippingPackaging
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the shipping packaging configuration page. Retrieves the current shipping configuration or initializes a default if none exists, and adds it to the model.

methods.name: saveShippingPackaging
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save shipping packaging settings. Updates the shipping configuration with form data and persists it.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the menu context for the admin interface, including active menu items.
